title: Well-Founded Progress — proof progress vs termination progress, multiset ranking; 'activity is not progress'

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Activity is not progress. A system can act a thousand times and accomplish nothing. Progress is measured against the obligation: a well-founded ranking (multiset ordering) over the proof state must strictly decrease with every claimed step — no infinite descent, so 'progress' that never terminates is impossible by construction. Two kinds of progress are separated: proof progress (the argument getting stronger) and termination progress (the work actually finishing). Budgets follow the obligation, not the agent: you don't get credit for being busy, you get credit for discharging what was owed. Branch-and-join and epochs handle parallel and phased work. The falsification test is the standing guard: 1,000 actions with zero obligations discharged = zero progress, and any meter that says otherwise is lying.

human_view.meaning: Doing things is not the same as getting things done. Progress means the actual obligation got smaller — and we measure it so strictly that endless busywork scores zero by definition.
human_view.why_it_matters: This is the law that makes every productivity claim honest. All the 'work completed' reports in the world mean nothing without it.

simple_view.meaning: Doing things is not the same as getting things done. Progress means the actual obligation got smaller — and we measure it so strictly that endless busywork scores zero by definition.

naya_view.directive: Measure progress against the obligation with a well-founded ranking; every claimed step must decrease it. Separate proof progress from termination progress. Attach budgets to obligations, not agents. Score 1,000 empty actions as zero — and distrust any meter that disagrees.

ai_view.specification: progress(step) valid iff rank(state') < rank(state) under a well-founded multiset ordering. Budgets bind to obligations. Falsification: 1000 actions ∧ 0 discharged → progress = 0.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.
